- HIPAA / BAA: We can provide a BAA if you elect Redwood Private (VPC). For Hosted customers we restrict HIPAA scope unless on a Dedicated/Private plan. Timeline for Private onboarding is typically 3-5 weeks from signature for infra readiness.

Akira / Camila —

I've reviewed your redline (thank you for clear comments). Summary of our position and proposed language:

1) Retention — Transaction logs: we can accept a seven-year retention for the specific transaction_logs dataset provided you accept a per-GB storage surcharge and we limit the scope explicitly in Schedule A. Proposed clause included in attached redline (BrokerTech_DPA_redline_v2.docx, comments in-line). Cost estimate: $0.02/GB/month incremental.

2) SCCs — We prefer to adopt Redwood's SCC template (we maintain a current Annex equivalent mapped to EU regs). If BrokerTech requires Annex V verbatim, we can accept it after legal review but will require an internal privacy approval (Neha). Suggest: accept BrokerTech Annex with a short addendum mapping responsibilities.

3) HIPAA/BAA — We confirm availability of a BAA for Private deployment only. Timing: 3 weeks for onboarding once Private contract and PO are in place; BAA can be executed in parallel with DPA signature.

4) Evidence — SOC 2 Type II summary attached; full report available under NDA. CAIQ export: note some answers are environment-specific (Hosted vs Private). If you share the primary workloads (engines, regions) we'll provide a tailored CAIQ.

Attached: BrokerTech_DPA_redline_v2.docx (with comments)

I recommend this flow: legal exchange redlines -> we converge on single mark -> security sign-off (Neha) -> commercial terms (retention cost) -> execution via DocuSign. Camila/Marissa — let me know if you want me to propose an internal approval ticket.

Diego

Camila/Diego —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few counterpoints from our side:

- We appreciate the scoped retention proposal. BrokerTech will accept the storage surcharge provided the retention clause includes automated deletion confirmation and a quarterly attest to deletion processes.
- On SCCs: we prefer Annex V (text included in our redline). If Redwood accepts Annex V, we can close privacy quickly; otherwise we will require an SOW referencing the SCC mapping which slows timeline.

One additional ask: BrokerTech requires liability carveouts for downstream processors that we manage (e.g., our analytics provider). Please propose language that excludes liability where BrokerTech-managed downstreams breach BrokerTech policies.

We're ready to proceed to signature once we have the final redline and the BAA pre-signed (if Redwood confirms Private). If you can circulate a DocuSign packet with the DPA and BAA tabs ready for parallel signature, that'll accelerate execution on our side.
